items.title: OCI Generative AI Supports OpenAI gpt-oss Models
items.content:
OCI Generative AI supports models OpenAI gpt-oss pre-trained, designed for reasoning and agenic tasks.

The text recommends openai.gpt-oss-120b for workloads and high consumption resources and openai.gpt-oss-20b for local use with lower latency.

The models are available under demand and as endpoints that are deployed in dedicated AI clusters. For details of the functions, the source refers to documentation from Generative AI.

items.title: Add Storage Files to Generative AI Applications
items.content:
The applications housed with OCI Generative AI now support storage persistent file. It can be used to save model artifacts, intermediate results, checkpoints and state application onto a configured container path, even after re-start and new implementations.

When creating a housed application, you can add up to 50 GB from storage file using Console or API. This version supports a replica with storage of archives. The minimum and maximum replica counts should be established at 1.
